name: Thomas Kuhn
shortBio: Historian and philosopher of science whose Structure of Scientific Revolutions challenged cumulative models of scientific progress with paradigm shifts.
centralQuestion: Does science progress cumulatively toward objective truth, or does it transform through discontinuous revolutions between incommensurable paradigms?

keyWorks.title: The Structure of Scientific Revolutions
keyWorks.description: Seminal text arguing that science progresses not through cumulative accretion, but through episodic revolutionary paradigm shifts.

keyWorks.title: The Copernican Revolution
keyWorks.description: Historical case study examining the shift from Ptolemaic geocentrism to heliocentric astronomy as a total conceptual reorientation.

keyWorks.title: The Essential Tension
keyWorks.description: Selected studies in scientific tradition and change examining the balance between convergent tradition and divergent innovation.
